summary: Draganfly Inc. filed a Material Change Report on Form 6-K disclosing the closing of its acquisition of Skip Dynamix Corporation (Pwise, Inc.) on June 11, 2026. The aggregate purchase price was up to US$7,525,000: US$2,525,000 cash at closing; US$2,500,000 in Draganfly common shares via special warrant at US$6.46 per share, contingent on founders' continued engagement for one year; and up to US$2,500,000 earn-out consideration payable in cash or up to 80% in shares. The acquisition positions Draganfly in defense drone markets. No board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock details are provided. Watch for earn-out milestone achievement and integration risks.
